name: Generate ROIs for Visual White Matter Tracking in dMRI Space (Benson pRF)
summary: Generates ROIs for visual white matter and optic radiation tracking in DWI space: V1 and other visual areas from a pRF/Benson visual-area segmentation, left and right LGN from FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei, the optic chiasm and FreeSurfer exclusion ROIs, using AFNI 3dROIMaker.
description: Converts FreeSurfer, thalamic-nuclei and pRF visual-area (varea) labels into DWI space and writes individual ROIs plus a combined visual-area parcellation, with optional inflation of the ROIs into white matter. Use it to prepare seed, target and exclusion ROIs for ROI-to-ROI tracking of the optic radiation. It needs a FreeSurfer output that includes the thalamic nuclei segmentation and a prf dataset with a varea surface; a brain mask is computed from the DWI with FSL bet unless one is supplied.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype

Path to the freesurfer datatype. This NEEDS to have been run through segment thalamic nuclei app, or have the thalamic nuclei generated in the original freesurfer generation, for this to work. This is used to generate the LGN ROIs.
inputs.requirements: Must contain the thalamic nuclei segmentation (mri/ThalamicNuclei.*.mgz), e.g. from the Segment thalamic nuclei App.

inputs.description: Specify this if you want to use your custom brainmask. If neither dtiinit nor brainmask is specified, this App will create brainmask from your dwi input using FSL bet.

This is the path to the prf datatype. This NEEDS to have a visual area segmentation (varea.nii.gz) for this to work. This is used to generate V1. The Benson anatomical atlas can be used to generate this segmentation.
inputs.requirements: Must contain lh.varea/rh.varea visual-area surfaces (e.g. from the Benson atlas).

outputs.description: Volumetric parcellation combining the visual-area ROIs from the pRF varea segmentation (plus LGN and optic chiasm), with key.txt and label.json, in DWI space.

Directory of individual binary NIfTI ROIs for visual white matter tracking: the left and right LGN (thalamic nuclei labels 8109/8209), the optic chiasm (aseg label 85), FreeSurfer-derived exclusion ROIs merged into an 'exclusion' ROI, and the visual-area ROIs.

parameters.description:
if ROI inflation into WM for thalamus segmentation is wanted, specify the number of inflated voxels desired

example: 1

if ROI inflation into WM for visual area segmentation is wanted, specify the number of inflated voxels desired

example: 1

if ROI inflation into WM for freesurfer segmentation is wanted, specify the number of inflated voxels desired

example: 1

failure_modes.cause: No ROIs were written to rois/rois.
failure_modes.fix: Check that the FreeSurfer input contains the thalamic nuclei segmentation and the prf input contains the varea surfaces.
